s.t:
ServiceNow empowers organizations with AI-driven autonomous workflows to streamline operations and achieve results. We seek an experienced solution sales specialist with business expertise and technical skills to drive growth for our Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.

This quota carrying sales role will partner with enterprise sales teams to identify opportunities, lead strategic discovery, demonstrate solutions, and close complex deals. Your dual expertise—part consultant, part seller—positions you to bridge technical capability and business value in ways that resonate with executive stakeholders.

Build and refine the qualification criteria, account strategy, sales motion, and the pitch.
Build pipeline and generate revenue for Autonomous Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.
Lead executive discovery sessions to uncover challenges and quantify AI value.
Develop account strategies focused on customer transformation.
Deliver impactful demonstrations and handle technical questions.
Establish trusted relationships with executive sponsors and collaborate across teams.
Stay informed about emerging AI technologies and workflow automation trends.
What Makes You Successful
Balance executive presence with technical know-how.
Simplify technology into clear business narratives.
Thrive in ambiguous situations and solve complex problems.
Prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Work well in matrixed environments.

7+ years of enterprise software sales or consulting experience.
Proven success selling complex SaaS, ERP, finance, legal, or AI solutions.
Domain expertise in procurement, financial operations, contract management, or legal tech.
Experience in overlay, matrixed, or specialized sales.
Skilled at leading executive engagements and product demonstrations.
Strong executive communication and organizational skills.
Willingness to travel

Experience selling or working with AI platforms and intelligent automation.
Familiarity with ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Ariba, Coupa, etc.
Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise architecture.
Active use of AI tools.
MBA or equivalent work experience.

Armis from ServiceNow is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales team. This role is crucial in driving top-of-funnel growth by identifying and qualifying high-potential leads for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of success in BDR roles, particularly within the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry. They will be a self-starter with excellent communication and organisational skills, and a strong understanding of the sales process.

Proactively identify and generate new business opportunities through targeted outbound prospecting, including cold calling, emailing, social selling, and leveraging relevant industry events.
Qualify and convert inbound leads generated from marketing campaigns, events and website inquiries.
Conduct thorough research to understand prospect needs, pain points, and business objectives.
Utilise CRM (Salesforce) to accurately track and manage all activities and interactions.

Schedule discovery calls for qualified sales opportunities for Account Executives.
Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Armis' products and services, and their value proposition to help accelerate opportunity progression.
Collaborate with marketing, channel and sales teams to optimise lead generation and qualification processes.
Territory buildout responsibilities in partnership with your Account Executives (account mapping, research, persona mapping)

Stay up-to-date on industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies in the cybersecurity space.
Develop a strong understanding of target industries and customer personas.
Provide feedback to marketing and product marketing teams based on prospect interactions and market insights.

Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified opportunities and meetings.
Provide regular reports on activity, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Participate in ongoing training and development to enhance sales skills and product knowledge.

Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a BDR or sales development role, preferably in the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry.
Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales targets.
Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and sales enablement tools.
Experience working collaboratively across business functions (Channel, Sales, Marketing).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong prospecting, qualification, and creative problem solving skills.
Ability to build rapport and establish relationships with potential customers.
Strong organisational and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Confidence in articulating a multi-product suite (platform sale).

Demonstrated ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into specific solutions with measurable business outcomes.
Strong follow-up skills to ensure customer satisfaction and continued success post-sale.

Hungry & Hardworking, self-motivated, results-driven, and goal-oriented with a strong desire to succeed.
Open to coaching, feedback, and continuous sales skills and technical knowledge improvement.

s.h: How You Will Make an Impact
s.t:
The Commercial Sales Associate is the main contact for sales and service in a thriving Commercial Tire Dealership. The Commercial Sales Associate is in charge of sales for area fleets as well as promoting new tires, retreads and tire services. Daily solicitation of existing store accounts, as well as calling on prospective new accounts are essential to building a profitable book of business.
Solicit commercial truck tire accounts in designated areas
Responsible for the sale of Industrial tires, new truck tires, retreads and services
Maintain current accounts with regular sales calls and follow up to accounts
Learn and work through the existing business operating system for billing of above sales channels
Maintain an acceptable profit margin
Actively seeking new accounts and represent the company to potential customers.
Developing and maintaining a thorough knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information to customers.
Meeting established sales and gross profit goals.
Evaluating customer needs and making recommendations
Preparing weekly sales plans and completing all call reports following established company procedures.

The Inbound Retail Sales Representative is a consultative sales professional who leverages their skills to offer customers personalized solutions with Blue Stream’s industry-leading products and services.

Using excellent, in-depth knowledge of company products and programs, this team member will drive customer adoption of Blue Stream’s full retail portfolio while also providing top-notch support and creating a positive customer experience.

Inbound Sales Representatives handle calls from customers wanting to set up new service, transferring service from one address to another, and/or adding a new product to their existing service. It is simple; our goal is to give our customers the best experience and the most value.

As a Blue Stream Fiber Inbound Sales Representative, you can be a part of doing just that. Key Responsibilities
Engage with both inbound and outbound calls from external and internal customers via voice, chat, email, text, and other platforms for sales and customer service-related situations.
Achieves sales and customer experience goals and objectives.
Executes on outbound calling campaigns involving residential customers.
Learns quickly, retains, and recalls product information while handling multiple priorities in a fast -paced environment.
Maintains satisfactory performance on efficiency, effectiveness, and quality metrics.
Maintains accurate and timely sales database documentation throughout all phases of the service and sales process.
Practices above average ability and accuracy in detailed work
Meet or exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) set by manager and business unit
Adherence to regular and predictable attendance and punctuality

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
Must be able to read, write and speak English. Can effectively present information and respond to questions from customers and technicians.
High School Diploma or equivalent
2 years related experience preferrable.
Customer/Client Focus
Flexibility
Works well in a team environment
Communication Proficiency
An understanding of technology
If working remotely, must have ability and willingness to meet in person at local call center as needed for meetings, group trainings, events, etc. A proven closer with sales experience (telecom sales a plus)
Understanding of the fundamentals of competitive environment.
Ability to multitask between multiple tools and systems (knowledge base, team meetings, supervisor) and apply information and knowledge to customer situations.
Ability to demonstrate functional skill in communicating and explaining basic account information to the customer including their billing statement, products, and services, with focus on first-call resolution, retaining revenue, and building value.
Overcome concerns, resolving customer concerns through active listening, empathy, professionalism, and problem solving.

We offer a full range of solutions, from standalone software packages for individual users, hosted software services, and enterprise-wide national systems.

We serve over 1,000 municipal, federal, state/provincial, hydropower, mining, academic, and consulting organizations in over 60 countries that collect, manage, and process large volumes of water data.

About the Business Development Representative
The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for proactively generating new outbound sales opportunities from scratch within an assigned territory.
This is a high-activity, outbound-focused role where success is driven by consistent execution across calling, emailing, and targeted outreach. BDRs serve as the front line of our go-to-market strategy , identifying potential customers, qualifying needs, and creating high-quality opportunities for Account Executives.
Why This Role?
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their career in technology sales. You'll gain hands-on experience in prospecting, discovery, qualification, and territory management while making a direct impact on business growth.
If you're energized by outbound sales, enjoy building relationships, and want to grow your career with a purpose-driven technology company, we'd love to hear from you.
📍US or Canada. This role is 100% remote.

🚀 A strong foundation for building a long-term career in SaaS and technology sales
📈 Clear opportunities for growth into other commercial roles.
💰 Competitive base salary plus variable incentive compensation tied to performance
🎯 Performance measured through a combination of activity, pipeline generation, and opportunity quality
🌟 Opportunity for additional incentives and expanded responsibilities as performance grows
🌎 The chance to make an impact by supporting organizations that manage one of the world's most critical resources: water
🏠 A fully remote and flexible work environment with a collaborative and supportive team culture
🤝 Exposure to cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success
🌐 Access to career development opportunities across Aquatic Informatics and Veralto's global family of companies
💡 Ongoing coaching, training, and professional development to help you succeed

Prospect into assigned accounts and territories through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and targeted campaigns to generate qualified pipeline.
Engage prospective customers, identify business needs and challenges, and conduct discovery conversations to assess solution fit.
Convert leads into qualified meetings, demos, and sales opportunities through consistent follow-up and relationship building.
Own and manage a defined territory, prioritizing accounts and maintaining accurate activity and pipeline data in Salesforce.
Track performance against key metrics and continuously refine your outreach strategy to improve results.
Partner closely with Account Executives to advance opportunities and ensure a smooth handoff process.
Collaborate with Marketing and Product teams to improve messaging, targeting, and overall go-to-market effectiveness.

1+ years of experience in a BDR, SDR, Inside Sales, or similar outbound sales role.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Environmental Science, or a related field preferred.
Experience in B2B and/or SaaS environment.
Proven success generating pipeline and achieving activity or opportunity targets.
Strong prospecting, discovery, and customer engagement skills.
Experience using CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through skills.

Title: Sales Development Representative Date: 7.26 Function: Sales Reports to: Director, Sales Development Location: United States - Remote Position Summary: As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for developing demand for the company's products and solutions.

In this role, you will establish relationships with prospective customers to create a viable sales pipeline through marketing lead generation campaigns and direct outreach. You will play an integral part in conveying the value of the platform to potential clients, directly impacting the company's future success.

Additionally, this role offers opportunities for growth and professional development both within and beyond the department.

Lead Qualification: Identify, engage, and qualify leads from various marketing channels (e.g., website, conferences, etc.) and ensure they align with the company’s solutions.
Conduct direct outreach to engage new leads while prospecting into a technical audience, applying a deep understanding of the B2B sales cycle, and effectively handling objections.
Analyze lead generation trends and optimize outreach efforts based on feedback and performance metrics.
Utilize phone, email, and social selling techniques to connect with key decision-makers, delivering compelling value propositions tailored to their needs.
Sales & Marketing Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between marketing and sales, actively engaging in marketing campaigns, analyzing trends, and collaborating with Account Executives to nurture key prospects and facilitate a seamless transition from prospecting to closing.

Quota Achievement: Engage new leads through direct outreach while developing a broader understanding of the B2B sales cycle, including prospecting into a technical audience and handling objections. Required to consistently meet or exceed assigned quotas for Booked Meetings and Sales Accepted Leads (SALs) contributing to overall revenue growth.

Pipeline & Performance Tracking: Consistently track and report key sales development metrics, including conversion rates, meeting attendance, and engagement trends. Tools & Technology Usage: Use a variety of sales tools (SalesForce, etc.) to maintain and record detailed and accurate records of customer interactions and pipeline.

Gain experience in a fast-paced culture with corporate exposure while contributing to marketing strategies and developing professionally. Proactively seeks knowledge and stays informed about industry trends and innovations.

Bachelor's Degree Required
Minimum 1+ years of proven sales development experience (exceeding quota) or customer-facing role engaging prospects while demonstrating strong communication, adaptability, and professionalism.
Minimum 1+ years working within a CRM system (Salesforce experience preferred).
Ability to support clients during EST time and currently based on the East coast
Develop and deliver compelling outreach through strong communication skills, while confidently speaking in front of an audience and handling objections effectively.
Strong organizational and time management abilities, with a disciplined approach to prospecting and follow-ups.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while maintaining a high level of self-motivation and discipline.
Comfortable speaking in front of an audience, whether in team meetings, client presentations, or sales pitches.
Demonstrate a growth mindset, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning, with a willingness to learn and be coached.
Competencies: Accountability Adaptability Applied Learning Business Acumen Collaboration Customer Focus Dealing w/Ambiguity Decision Making Driving for Results Initiating Action Planning and Organizing Technical/Professional Knowledge/Skills

If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. What You’ll Be Doing As a BDR
In this role, you’ll be a key player in our fast-paced and highly innovative engineering team. You will:
Be the first point of contact for new business prospects and expose them to JFrog products and value proposition.
Navigate complex business environments and uncover and translate needs into business opportunities.
Research and evaluate prospect accounts prior to engagement.
Interact with prospects through direct phone calls, emails, and social media.
Generate new business pipeline through outbound prospecting activities and inbound lead follow-up.
Maintain sales data through Salesforce that will influence monthly/quarterly sales reports, pipelines, forecasts, etc.
Collaborate with sales and marketing to build a sales strategy for generating new prospects.

High-Value Conversions

* Consultative selling approach with a focus on revenue generation

s.h: ## CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE BOUGER ##
s.t:
Tu souhaites faire évoluer les clients, tu es à l'aise dans le monde Microsoft Cloud, plateformes et sécurité et tu as le sens des opportunités et des défis que la digitalisation offre à nos clients et à leurs entreprises ?

Alors tu es exactement à la bonne place chez nous dans le Business Development pour le Microsoft Competence Center chez adesso !

En lien avec tes connaissances informatiques de base, tu agis comme interface centrale entre nos clients, les ventes et nos consultants, lorsqu'il s'agit de l'orientation professionnelle et stratégique d'adesso dans le domaine des Microsoft Clouds, plateformes et solutions de sécurité.
En tant que Business Developer, tu es le partenaire d'échange des cadres et de nos Account Managers pour la croissance et tu convaincs nos clients par ta grande expertise dans le monde Microsoft - du Cloud et des plateformes jusqu'à la sécurité.

s.h: De plus, les tâches suivantes t'attendent
s.t:
* Tu mets tes idées en œuvre avec enthousiasme dans le développement de solutions numériques sur mesure et sécurisées
* Tu identifies les besoins en sécurité et les potentiels commerciaux chez nos clients et développes avec nos consultants des solutions adaptées autour de Microsoft Security - de l'identité et la conformité à la protection contre les menaces et aux opérations de sécurité
* Grâce à une communication forte combinée à ta grande expertise professionnelle et ton talent organisationnel, tu gagnes tes clients en prévente et orchestras notre équipe de prévente
* Sur la base de la planification de comptes que tu as élaborée, tu atteins tes objectifs avec succès
* En collaboration avec les ventes et les cadres du Microsoft Competence Center, tu assures notre succès dans l'acquisition de clients et de commandes

s.t:
Notre promesse : tu te sentiras bien chez nous ! Collégial, communautaire et sur un pied d'égalité - nous vivons l'échange, l'esprit d'équipe et un respect mutuel. La diversité et les différents points de vue sont aussi appréciés chez nous que toi en tant que personne. Cela et bien plus encore représente notre sentiment très particulier d'appartenance. Pour lequel il existe même un mot : adessi.
* **Apprends et grandis avec nous :** Avec plus de 400 offres de formation et notre plateforme d'apprentissage numérique, nous soutenons ton développement continu.
* **Vis un véritable esprit d'équipe :** Des événements communs (par ex. week-end sportif et le voyage annuel de formation eduCamp), des journées d'accueil, des courses d'entreprise renforcent notre cohésion et te font sentir membre de l'équipe dès le début.
* **Engagement récompensé :** Ton engagement est récompensé - avec des primes pour les recommandations, les conférences, l'encadrement des travaux de fin d'études ainsi que des réductions attractives via notre portail Corporate Benefits.
Notre culture et notre collaboration sont marquées par la reconnaissance, l'appréciation et le soutien mutuels. Cela nous unit - même en télétravail. Le travail à temps partiel est possible sur accord (80-100%). Nous avons été à plusieurs reprises élus parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Suisse !

Notre large offre de formation et un modèle transparent de progression de carrière pour tous garantissent que ton développement chez nous ne stagne pas. Car grandir ensemble et être donneur de chances, c'est inscrit dans notre ADN.

Who are we?
HubSpot is a leading customer relationship management (CRM) platform for scaling companies. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world use our marketing, sales, and customer success software to grow their businesses. It's our mission to not just help them grow, but to help them grow better.
At HubSpot, we believe that our values live in our hearts, not our hallways. We want to build a company where people feel empowered to do their best work, wherever they are. Our ANZ office is located in Sydney’s CBD but this role offers flexibility to work remotely or in a hybrid arrangement. Applicants must be based in Australia's East Coast.

Do you want to join a high-producing and impactful sales and service team at HubSpot? The mission of the Associate Inbound Success Coach (customer service) team is to provide customers and prospects with the most immediate and high quality first interaction with HubSpot in order to drive great customers. This is an entry level role perfect for someone passionate about building a career in sales with progression opportunities into a Business Development Representative.
What will you do?
Navigate a high volume of product and sales related inquiries
Conduct consultative pre-qualification of prospects for HubSpot’s sales process via phone, live chat, and email
Help remove technical barriers for our users and recommend software best practices
Set up high quality appointments with the appropriate sales team members for Inbound Growth Assessments
Identify and deliver best next steps or resources to assist customers and users
Collaborate cross-functionally within HubSpot to improve experience for HubSpotters and HubSpot customers/users alike
Who are you?
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A strong technical aptitude to help our users succeed with the HubSpot software
A passion for helping our prospects businesses grow
Initiative to find the resources needed to be successful in this role
An ability to work collaboratively to solve problems

How will you excel in this role?
A strong interest in a career in sales and a passion to solve for customers
Genuine curiosity about business and technology
A growth mindset and a habit of seeking feedback for self-development
Ability to pick up new platforms and processes quickly
High performance in previous roles and areas outside of professional work (E.g hobbies, sport, creative)

Generous remuneration and stock units
Hybrid work environment You can choose to work from Home, Office or Flex!
World class new hire training and onboarding

Werde Sales Executive (m/w/d) bei Carwow !

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen.

Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt.

Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser:innen. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang.

Als Sales Executive (m/w/d) bist du neben unserem Business Development und dem Account Management der dritte wichtige Baustein unserer Vertriebsspitze. Denn als Sales Executive sorgst du für ein erstklassiges (Ver)Kaufserlebnis unserer Kund:innen und Partner auf unserer Plattform.

Du berätst Verkäufer:innen beim Verkauf ihrer Autos über unsere "Sell My Car"-Plattform und stellst den Kontakt zu Partnerhändlern her, um so ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis auf beiden Seiten zu schaffen
Dabei kommunizierst du über verschiedene Kanäle wie zum Beispiel Telefon, E-Mail oder WhatsApp, um einen effizienten Verkaufsprozess zu gewährleisten und steigerst so die Zufriedenheit von Verkäufer:innen und Händlern
Denn ohne dein Zutun würden viele Verkäufe sprichwörtlich auf der Strecke bleiben, du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Verkäufer:innen und Händlern und sorgst so kontinuierlich für hohe Verkaufsquoten

Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst und Lust auf Automotive hast, dann freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.
Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Auftreten - auch bei unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen
Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise aus dem Automotive Retail / Autohandel oder vergleichbaren Rollen, sowie Empathie und zwischenmenschliches Gespür
Begeisterung für die Automobilbranche: Du bist bestens über Trends und Entwicklungen informiert und weißt, was “da draußen im Markt” passiert
Analytisches Denken: Die Fähigkeit, Daten zu nutzen, um Chancen und Risiken zu erkennen
Hands-on-Mentalität, hohe Eigenmotivation und Belastbarkeit in einem dynamischen Scale-up

In der Regel kannst du etwa mit zwei bis drei Wochen für den Bewerbungsprozess rechnen.
Talent Screen (telefonisch) mit unserem Recruiting Team - ca. 30 Minuten
Video Interview (online) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 30 Minuten
Case Study (vor Ort) mit dem Fachbereich - ca. 60 Minuten
Final Values & Team Fit (vor Ort oder online) nach Möglichkeit im Anschluss an deine Case Study - ca. 30 Minuten

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
In this role, you'll convert high-intent inbound interest into a qualified pipeline for the business. You'll work closely with our Marketing team to maximise the return on events(webinars, trade shows, DeepL Connect, virtual events) and always-on campaigns (contact forms, trials, white papers, content downloads). As often the first person a prospect speaks to, you'll shape their entire experience with DeepL from the very first touch.
We're looking for an energetic, curious, and team-oriented people. You should have a passion for communication and languages, and a desire to be part of a hyper-growth scale-up!

Inbound Lead Management
Respond rapidly to inbound leads from contact forms, free trials, webinars, and content downloads
Prioritise leads based on intent signals, ensuring timely, relevant, and value-driven communication
Nurture prospects who aren't immediately ready, keeping them warm with helpful content and well-timed follow-up
Own end-to-end follow-up for event leads, maintaining quality and speed even during high-volume periods

Apply a structured qualification framework to ensure every meeting is well-documented and properly qualified
Convert inbound interest into well-prepared, qualified sales opportunities
Articulate the value of our product suite clearly, creating curiosity and clear next steps
Meet and exceed monthly targets for pipeline contribution
Stakeholder & Team Collaboration
Work closely with stakeholders based in Germany, taking initiative to keep communication proactive across time zones and locations
Maintain accurate, complete records in your CRM for every interaction
Share insights on lead quality and messaging effectiveness to help improve campaign performance
Bring ideas that help the team improve how it converts inbound interest, moving beyond a purely passive, reactive approach

Fluency in German and English (written and spoken)
Around 12 months of relevant sales or customer-facing experience (SDR/BDR/Inside Sales), ideally in SaaS
Highly organised, with strong personal initiative — comfortable driving your own workload with minimal oversight
Confidence working with stakeholders based remotely in Germany
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly
Strong time management; able to juggle multiple leads, channels, and priorities
Nice-to-Haves
Some outbound prospecting experience
Experience with DACH enterprise or mid-market prospects
Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement tools (e.g. Salesforce, Salesloft)
Interest in helping improve how the team converts and engages inbound leads
Fluency in another European language
What Success Looks Like
You consistently deliver qualified meetings per month with strong opportunity acceptance rates
You maintain rapid speed-to-lead across all inbound channels
German-based stakeholders value your proactive communication and reliability
You contribute ideas that help sharpen how the team converts and engages inbound interest
You demonstrate growing commercial judgement and confidence handling a wider range of inbound scenarios

We are an equal opportunity employer
You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

If you are looking for an internship where you can develop your business acumen, analytical capabilities and strategic thinking while contributing to the growth of a pharmaceutical company with international ambitions, this opportunity is for you. Serviceorientierung: Du hilfst Menschen gerne und hast Freude daran, sowohl beratend als auch praktisch anzupacken.

We're building the SDR function at Leapsome from the ground up, and you'd be the third person on the team. That's a different job than joining an established sales org. Day to day, you'll research and reach out to HR and People leaders who could genuinely benefit from Leapsome, qualify them, and hand off strong opportunities to our AEs. Das **Beratungs- & Coachingzentrum (StS)** der Abteilung Studentische Dienste (StS), angegliedert beim Rektor der ETH Zürich, bietet neben einem breiten Beratungsspektrum viele verschiedene Unterstützungsangebote für Studieninteressierte und Studierende an.
Wir suchen per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung in einem Pensum von 80% eine:n Berater:in und Coach in der Gruppe «Besondere Studiensituationen und Master Studierende». Die Stelle ist für ein Jahr befristet.
Die Gruppe «Besondere Studiensituationen und Master Studierende» unterstützt Studierende beratend in verschiedenen besonderen Studiensituationen wie Studium und Behinderung oder chronische Erkrankung, Studium und Spitzensport etc. Dazu arbeitet sie eng mit internen und externen Fachstellen zusammen. Ausserdem begleitet sie in- und ausländische Master Studierende mit Events beim Onboarding sowie mit Workshops zu überfachlichen Kompetenzen während dem Studium.
Arbeiten Sie gerne mit jungen Erwachsenen und unterstützen diese in komplexen Lebens- und Studiensituationen? Verstehen Sie es, dabei innerhalb von vorgegebenen Rahmenbedingungen zu agieren? Dann sind Sie die richtige Person für uns.

Warum Hilti
Hilti ist ein global führendes Unternehmen in der Bauinnovation mit mehr als 34\.000 Teammitgliedern in 120 Ländern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Bauwesen zu verbessern. Deshalb liegt es uns am Herzen, zu lernen, zu wachsen und neue Wege zu finden, eine bleibende Wirkung zu erzielen.

Hier kannst Du Deine Stärken einbringen, mit einem globalen und inklusiven Team zusammenarbeiten und Dich sinnvollen Herausforderungen stellen. Bei Hilti kannst Du Deine Ideen durch zielgerichtetes Handeln, Leidenschaft und Teamwork in reale Errungenschaften und Wachstum verwandeln.
Verpflichtung zur Inklusion
Inklusion ist bei Hilti ein zentraler Aspekt unserer Arbeitsweise, unseres Führungsstils und unseres gemeinsamen Wachstums. Wir engagieren uns aktiv für Gedankenvielfalt und ein Umfeld, das für alle und überall inklusiv ist. Wir streben fortlaufend danach, dass jede Stimme gehört wird und sich jedes Teammitglied befähigt fühlt, sich einzubringen. Indem wir dieses Fundament schaffen, stärken wir unsere Teams, unsere Innovation und unsere Wirkung, um gemeinsam das Bauwesen zu verbessern.
Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt, bei einem der besten Arbeitgeber der Schweiz zu arbeiten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Online\-Bewerbung. Deine vollständigen Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, CV, Zeugnisse) nehmen wir über unser Online\-Karrieretool entgegen. Frau Joèlle , HR Talent Partner, freut sich auf Dein Anschreiben und steht Dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung: [E\-Mail schreiben](<>)
Was kannst Du erwarten, wenn du Dich bei Hilti bewirbst?
\- Wir verpflichten uns, alle Bewerbungen von einem Menschen prüfen zu lassen. Auch wenn niemand unfehlbar ist, stehen wir bei allem, was wir tun, zu unserem personenzentrierten Ansatz.
\- Sobald Du Deine Bewerbung eingereicht hast, erhältst Du automatische Benachrichtigungen von unserem System (ausgelöst durch unser Rekrutierungsteam).
\- Bewerbungen, die es nicht bis zum Vorstellungsgespräch mit einem einstellenden Manager schaffen, erhalten kein personalisiertes Feedback.
\- Du kannst davon ausgehen, dass Du innerhalb von 2\-3 Wochen (im Durchschnitt) von uns hörst \- unabhängig vom Ergebnis. Der gesamte Einstellungsprozess kann zwischen 5 und 6 Wochen dauern.

ABOUT YOU & THE ROLE 🚀 What is Synera ? — Where AI Meets Deep-Tech Synera is on a mission to accelerate engineering with AI. We’ve built the industry’s leading AI Agent platform for engineering teams, enabling companies to turn complex, manual workflows into automated processes — cutting weeks of engineering work down to minutes.

Our AI agents integrate seamlessly with the tools engineers already use, remove bottlenecks in real-world product development, and help deep-tech companies move faster without compromising quality. In a world where engineering speed is a competitive advantage, Synera is defining the new standard.

Having just closed our series B, we’re a fast-growing team, and we’re rapidly expanding our Revenue teams in Germany and the United States to support increasing demand from innovative deep-tech companies.

If you’re excited about selling cutting-edge AI, working close to the market, and building something early — and if you have big plans for your future — now is the right time to join us. 👉 Your Role Joining us as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) in the US, you’ll be the first voice our future customers hear — C-level deciders, engineering leaders, innovation teams, and thought leaders at forward-thinking deep-tech companies.

Your mission: turn curiosity into conversations, and conversations into real business opportunities. Let’s be real: this role is hands-on. You’ll spend a lot of time picking up the phone, sending messages, following up, and getting through to tough prospects.

Along the way, you will learn how to position and pitch an AI product that delivers value, and how to drive thought leadership in the field of AI. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing, test different outreach strategies, and help shape how Synera goes to market in the US.

If you enjoy momentum, love the challenge of getting a “yes” from a skeptical prospect, and want to open doors that lead to big deals — we want to hear from you. If you are hungry to take the first step towards a sales career in one of the most exciting fields there is, you have come to the right place. 👉 Your main focus areas:
Pipeline Building: You qualify leads and set up meetings for the Account Executive team.
Prospect & Qualify: You engage senior leaders and decision-makers via cold outreach (email, LinkedIn, calls, reaching 60+ activities per day).
Outbound Excellence: You shape and manage targeted outbound campaigns, working with the Marketing team to optimize messaging.
Engage & tell great stories: You spark interest in Synera ’s Agentic AI solutions through compelling storytelling and value-driven conversations. You experiment and find creative ways to engage with senior leaders and build trustful relationships
Iterate & Improve: You analyze outreach performance, test new approaches, and refine our SDR playbook.

You know our domain inside out: who our ideal customers are, what keeps them up at night, and how Synera solves their biggest challenges. You have become an AI native, and curiosity is what drives you daily.
You routinely create great Discovery Calls, proving you can turn outreach into meaningful conversations for our Sales team. You have gained great confidence in explaining and pitching a complex tech product.
You are a power user of our tools and workflows - from prospecting platforms to CRM systems. Giving and receiving feedback has become a normal part of your day.
You understand what makes our product special and be able to speak authentically about the value we bring to teams who want to transform what they do with AI. You love to share knowledge and good practices in an international team.
Here is our team at last year’s summer event - join us at the next one! 👋 🌱 What’s in it for you? We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:
Entry Level (OTE): 73.000 - 89.000$
Intermediate (OTE): 85.000 - 109.000$
Please note that the salary bands above apply to the Boston area, as an example and may vary by location. We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive.

While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role. Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine. What we offer beyond salary:
Flexible working: you decide when and where to work (as long as you have a residency in the US).
Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!
Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen, or co-working space in Boston.
Personal development budget of $2,500. You’ll also have the chance to grow together with us!
We don't count your vacation days as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.
Access to the mental health platform nilo to support your well-being.
We support you with health insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan.
Regular team events, in the US or abroad (Germany)🌈
Requirements 🚀 What you need to succeed Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.
You resonate with Synera 's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.
You have solid and proven experience in outbound activities in B2B SaaS environment.
You can showcase your track record with convincing results (e.g. overachieving quota for multiple quarters).
You are able to pitch complex technical solutions (bonus if you have experience in AI, CAD, CAE, or engineering automation).
You handle rejections and iterate quickly, you are resilient with a growth mindset.
You know CRM systems, cold outreach tools, and LinkedIn prospecting (e.g. Salesforce, Clay, Sales Navigator, Aircall).
You enjoy hunting for opportunities!
P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow and every voice is valued.
